root_cause: CustomPaint was a fixed DisplayList with no child slot and no foreground painter; painters were evaluated eagerly at construction, so shouldRepaint was never consulted.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/painting.rs (CustomPaint gains painter, foreground_painter, child; From<CustomPaint> composes a Stack (Passthrough, Clip::None) whose painter, child and foreground layers are Positioned.fill(IgnorePointer(...)) siblings); crates/incular-widgets/src/painting_effects/custom_paint.rs (PainterDelegate: type-erased painter evaluated at paint time, with a shouldRepaint gate); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/specs.rs, tree.rs, tree/widget/structure.rs, tree/rendering/lowering/visual.rs, tree/painting/behavior/visual.rs (painter paints at the laid-out size); crates/incular-widgets/src/render_object/update.rs (delegate_keeps_output: keep the picture when shouldRepaint is false)
harness: not run: no scenario twin added in this pass
api_change: CustomPaint::from_painter now takes a 'static painter and paints at paint time (same output at a fixed size). New builders: painter, foreground_painter, child, preferred_size, fill_to_constraints; from_painter_filling. CustomPaint::new is unchanged.
limitations: Painter layers ignore pointer input (IgnorePointer), matching Flutter's default hitTestSelf of false. With a child or foreground, the painter layers are Stack siblings rather than one node, so the layer count grows.
note: Flutter: rendering/custom_paint.dart paint order and size rules; widgets/basic.dart:831-884.

root_cause: Clip widgets stored static rect, radii or path values; geometry was never derived from the laid-out size by a delegate, and no reclip decision existed.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/clipping.rs (CustomClipper trait with get_clip(size) -> ClipShape and should_reclip; ClipShape enum Rect/RRect/Path; type-erased ClipDelegate; custom_clipper builders on ClipRect, ClipRRect, ClipOval, ClipPath); crates/incular-widgets/src/render_object/layers.rs (clip_geometry resolves geometry from delegate and size; apply_clip keeps the compositor clip when size and clip inputs are unchanged and the delegate does not reclip; ClipApplied records the source delegate and size); crates/incular-widgets/src/render_object/update.rs (delegate_keeps_output); tree.rs, tree/specs.rs, tree/widget/structure.rs, tree/rendering/lowering/layout.rs (clipper field on the four clip kinds)
harness: not run: no scenario twin added in this pass
api_change: Additive: custom_clipper(impl CustomClipper) builder on ClipRect, ClipRRect, ClipOval and ClipPath; new exports CustomClipper and ClipShape (incular-widgets and facade). ClipPath.custom_clipper replaces the fixed path. A Rect returned for ClipRRect uses the widget radius; a Path returned for ClipRect or ClipOval uses its bounds; non-path shapes for ClipPath become rectangle paths.
limitations: Reclip state compares against the delegate that produced the geometry. A chain of two non-reclipping delegates is compared with the geometry source rather than the immediately previous delegate, a small divergence from Flutter's latest-set comparison. The clip is raster-only, as the existing clip widgets are.
note: Flutter: widgets/basic.dart:950-1353; rendering/proxy_box.dart CustomClipper (_RenderCustomClip reclip logic).

root_cause: CustomPaint preferred size was a finite Size, so Flutter's Size.infinite fill pattern could not be expressed and panicked on construction.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/layout/basic/painting.rs (size is Option<Size>; None fills the constraints through from_painter_filling and fill_to_constraints); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/layout/behavior/core.rs (CustomPaint desired is Option<Size>; None uses constraints.biggest()); crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs (main-extent hint maps the optional size)
api_change: Additive: fill_to_constraints(), from_painter_filling(), preferred_size(). CustomPaint::new(Size, DisplayList) is unchanged; Size itself remains finite-only.

root_cause: SlideTransition::from_animation always built FractionalTranslation with transform_hit_tests true; no setter was exposed to callers.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/explicit_animations.rs (SlideTransition::from_animation_with_options(position, text_direction, transform_hit_tests, child); from_animation_in_direction delegates with true, so existing callers are unchanged)
harness: not run: no scenario twin added in this pass
api_change: Additive: SlideTransition::from_animation_with_options. Existing from_animation and from_animation_in_direction are unchanged.
limitations: Transform.transformHitTests, which the brief names, is not exposed. The tree Transform kind carries the flag, but the Transform descriptor in tree/descriptors.rs still builds it as true. Left for a follow-up.
